scope: Close the source-parsed-cache emission gap and verify the adapter's handle-backed raw-plus-typed duplicate refusal under the existing focused proxy-graphics selector.

method.kind: Locally generated complete ASCII/Binary DXF inputs with parser provenance, explicit acknowledgement, strict writer emission, literal wire inspection, and reimport checks
method.limitations: The parsed-cache matrix covers AC1021/group-92 and AC1024/group-160 only. Duplicate refusal is verified when typed and raw records share a nonzero handle. It does not prove duplicate identity when source handles are absent or ambiguous, all version/entity profiles, or external producer/consumer behavior.

controls.topic: Parsed cache default-deny then explicit replay
controls.observed: Generated AC1021/group-92 and AC1024/group-160 inputs in ASCII and Binary are parsed through dx_iface. The test checks ParsedDxf origin, source encoding/version/codepage/count, exact cache bytes, and unauthorized default state. It then calls the no-argument profile-bound acknowledgment and strictly exports at the same version to both ASCII and Binary.
assertions: exact parsed and emitted proxy payload and declared count
correct 92 or 160 count group and literal chunk values
reimported cache is default-deny rather than inheriting caller acknowledgment
following LINE identity and coordinates survive

controls.observed: A generated raw LINE and typed proxy-cached LINE sharing one nonzero source handle are refused by the existing dx_iface raw/typed identity preflight before a destination is created.
doesNotEstablish: identity of duplicate records when the source handle is absent or ambiguous
a duplicate publication path that has not passed adapter preflight
semantic equivalence of arbitrary raw and typed entity payloads

remainingWork: add relevant version/entity profiles at the existing focused selector
resolve duplicate identity only if a route can produce handle-less or ambiguous raw/typed records
retain peer/native/independent semantic qualification at the composed checkpoint
